study_year: anonymous year; original file exposes MMDD only
selection_rule: top weekly orders among AOIs active on all seven selected days
satellite_location_basis: median LaDe accept_gps coordinate by region/week

central_depot.name: 杭州萧山国际机场旧货运中心（中心仓代理点）
central_depot.source: Wikimedia Commons geotag; YTO processing facility visible

distance_matrix_source: OSRM public driving table snapshot (OpenStreetMap road network)

distance_matrix_quality.note: The largest snap is the public cargo-hub proxy coordinate; the raw response is retained.

delivery_time_window_basis: LaDe observed delivery completion 5th-95th percentile, expanded by 30 minutes, rounded to 30 minutes, and widened to at least 6 hours; this is a service-band proxy, not an observed promised time window
pickup_time_window_basis: designed window: pickup starts no earlier than both the configured afternoon threshold and the delivery due time; it ends at the configured evening cutoff

return_model.status: scenario assumption; LaDe-D has no reusable-packaging return records

payload_kg_per_order.status: scenario assumption; LaDe-D has no parcel-weight field
